about_the_game:
You are the last Guardian, the protector of the ancient energy ring. After centuries of slumber, you have awakened to defend the Edge of Orbit from the onslaught of faceless forms.

Each new invasion triggers another cycle of defense, and with every battle, you grow stronger.

Collect resources, unlock dozens of upgrades, adapt your tactics, and step by step move closer to your ultimate goal — break the eternal cycle and save the Edge of Orbit.

⚡ Fast-Paced and Intense Sessions

Short, dynamic battles lasting only a few minutes, where every decision matters. Progress carries over between cycles, allowing you to grow stronger and advance toward your goal.

🎯 Dodge and Strike

Face waves of geometric enemies using agility, strategy, and precise timing for counterattacks. Each cycle demands new tactics — hone your skills and become unstoppable.

🛠 Extensive Upgrades

Collect resources and unlock dozens of upgrades: enhance your weapons, reinforce your shields, develop special abilities, and combine them to create unique strategies. With each cycle, your arsenal becomes broader and more powerful.

🌌 The Final Goal

Push forward to the Singularity and escape the endless orbit. Only by overcoming each cycle and mastering your abilities can you shatter the loop and achieve true freedom.

In LOOPINITY: Break the Cycle, every cycle is a step toward freedom.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: 2 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan 1.0
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: 3.5 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: LOOPINITY: Break the Cycle is a short incremental game that immerses you in a world of endless cycles and geometric chaos. Take control of a rift guardian, fend off waves of enemies, collect valuable resources, and upgrade your abilities. Break the closed orbit and achieve long-awaited freedom.
